architecturalDecisions.title: Two-pathway persistence
architecturalDecisions.decision: Grocery item writes (grocery_items row + grocery_items↔stores + grocery_items↔saved_items relink) are live; saved item writes (saved_items row + saved_items↔stores + local-saved-item upsert) are performed on sheet close.

architecturalDecisions.title: Snapshot-based dirty tracking
architecturalDecisions.decision: A snapshot of the item state is captured on present() and rebased on autocomplete pick. Close-time work is driven by diffing current state against the snapshot. String fields are compared after trimming.

architecturalDecisions.title: Instant writer function split
architecturalDecisions.decision: Extract updateGroceryItemOnly (grocery_items + grocery_items↔stores + grocery_items↔saved_items relink) and syncSavedItemFromGroceryItem (saved_items + saved_items↔stores + local upsert, owner-gated). The existing updateGroceryListItem becomes a thin wrapper composing both so the Add Item flow is unaffected.

architecturalDecisions.title: Live sync hook location
architecturalDecisions.decision: A new useLiveItemSync hook is composed into EditItemProvider. The shared useItemSheet hook stays unchanged.

architecturalDecisions.title: Debounce contract
architecturalDecisions.decision: Text fields (name, notes) use a 300ms trailing debounce via useDebounceCallback from usehooks-ts. Non-text fields (category, quantity, unit, storeId) fire immediately. The debounce is flushed synchronously on sheet close and cancelled on autocomplete pick.

architecturalDecisions.title: Sheet close event mapping
architecturalDecisions.decision: onStartClose flushes pending debounce and performs close-time saved-item sync. onDismiss resets form state and clears the snapshot ref.

architecturalDecisions.title: Ownership is carried on autocomplete matches
architecturalDecisions.decision: MatchingItem gains an optional ownerId sourced from useUnifiedSavedItems. This allows the close-time saved-item sync to apply the owner gate without a follow-up query after autocomplete pick.

architecturalDecisions.title: Error handling
architecturalDecisions.decision: Live writes rely on Instant's optimistic UI and offline queue. No new catch-and-toast error surface is introduced.

architecturalDecisions.title: Scope fence
architecturalDecisions.decision: Only the Edit Item sheet moves to live updates. The Add Item sheet continues to use the existing submit-on-confirm flow.

tickets.title: Add pure diffItemSnapshot helper
tickets.summary: Introduce a pure function that takes a snapshot and a current-state object and returns only the fields that differ. String fields compare after trimming. No React, no Instant.
acceptanceCriteria: Exports a function that accepts { snapshot, current } and returns a partial object limited to changed fields.
Covers name, category, notes, quantity, unit, storeId at minimum.
String diffs are computed on trimmed values (e.g. 'foo' vs 'foo ' is not a diff).
Returns an empty object when snapshot and current are equivalent.
Handles undefined-vs-empty-string consistently for optional string fields.
testPlan: Vitest unit tests under components/item-sheet (colocated with existing __tests__) covering equal state, single-field diffs across each field, trim-equivalence, undefined/null vs empty string, and multi-field diffs.
pnpm test
outOfScope: Wiring the helper into the hook or the close path (later phase).

tickets.title: Extract updateGroceryItemOnly writer
tickets.summary: Pull the grocery_items row update, grocery_items↔stores link reconcile, and grocery_items↔saved_items relink out of updateGroceryListItem into a standalone writer. It does NOT touch saved_items rows, saved_items↔stores, or local-saved-item upsert.
acceptanceCriteria: Exports updateGroceryItemOnly with typed inputs covering item fields, currentStoreId, and the relink trio (currentSavedItemId, selectedSavedItemId, selectedLocalSavedItemId).
Performs grocery_items.update with trim-normalized fields.
Delegates store link/unlink to linkStoreToItem with unchanged semantics.
Performs relink transactions only when selectedSavedItemId differs from currentSavedItemId, and unlinks currentSavedItemId when selectedLocalSavedItemId is provided.
No saved_items writes and no upsertLocalSavedItem calls.
testPlan: No unit tests: db.transact is the only observable effect and stubbing it would couple tests to call shape/order (implementation detail). Behavior is validated via the P1-T4 wrapper smoke test and end-to-end flows in later phases.
pnpm tsc
outOfScope: Call-site migration (Add flow still goes through the wrapper).

tickets.title: Extract syncSavedItemFromGroceryItem writer
tickets.summary: Pull the saved_items row update, saved_items↔stores reconcile, and local-saved-item upsert out of updateGroceryListItem. The owner gate lives inside this function so callers don't duplicate it.
acceptanceCriteria: Exports syncSavedItemFromGroceryItem with typed inputs covering nextSavedItemId, currentSavedItemOwnerId, selectedLocalSavedItemId, item (partial), a savedItemStoreId baseline, and currentItemName.
Is a no-op when there is nothing to write (empty item + no store change + no local selection + no cloud target).
When no cloud saved item is linked (or selectedLocalSavedItemId is set), calls upsertLocalSavedItem with the provided fields.
Skips saved_items.update when the current user does not own the target saved item.
When owned, writes saved_items.update with trim-normalized fields and reconciles saved_items↔stores against savedItemStoreId baseline.
testPlan: No unit tests: db.transact and upsertLocalSavedItem are the only observable effects and stubbing them would couple tests to call shape/order (implementation detail). Behavior is validated via the P1-T4 wrapper smoke test and end-to-end flows in later phases.
pnpm tsc
outOfScope: Diff computation (handled by P1-T1 and wired in later phases).

tickets.title: Recompose updateGroceryListItem as a wrapper

acceptanceCriteria: updateGroceryListItem produces the same externally observable sequence of Instant writes as before for representative inputs.
All existing call sites continue to import updateGroceryListItem without modification.
No duplication of logic between the wrapper and the two extracted writers.
testPlan: Manual smoke: Add Item sheet and Edit Item sheet (with the current button flow) still create and update items as before on iOS simulator.

tickets.title: Introduce useLiveItemSync hook with snapshot and live writes

Close-time saved-item sync in this phase still uses the existing updateGroceryListItem wrapper called once with final state; the diff-optimized sync arrives in P4.

Snapshot is captured when the Edit sheet is presented with an item; cleared on dismiss.
Name and notes writes are debounced with a 300ms trailing delay; category, quantity, unit, and storeId writes are immediate.
Empty-name state skips the live write entirely.
Exposes a flushAndSyncOnClose function callable from onStartClose that flushes pending debounce synchronously and then commits final state.
No new error handling beyond existing Instant optimistic behavior.

tickets.title: Replace close-time wrapper call with diff-driven saved-item sync
tickets.summary: In useLiveItemSync, compute the diff between the (possibly rebased) snapshot and current state using diffItemSnapshot. On sheet close, after flushing pending debounce, invoke syncSavedItemFromGroceryItem with only the diffed fields. Skip the call entirely when the diff is empty. The owner gate continues to live inside the writer.
acceptanceCriteria: flushAndSyncOnClose no longer calls updateGroceryListItem; it calls updateGroceryItemOnly (for any pending flush) and syncSavedItemFromGroceryItem (for the diff), in that order.
When the diff is empty, syncSavedItemFromGroceryItem is not invoked.
When the linked saved_item is not owned by the current user, saved_items row writes are skipped (validated inside the writer).
When no cloud saved_item is linked and there is a diff, upsertLocalSavedItem runs via the writer as before.
Editing only non-saved-item fields (e.g. quantity) produces no saved_items writes on close.
testPlan: Manual: change only quantity, close — confirm saved_items row is untouched (inspect Instant dashboard or query).
Manual: as owner, change category + notes, close — saved_items row and store link reflect changes.
Manual: on an item linked to a saved_item owned by another user, change name, close — grocery item name updates, saved_item name is not touched.

acceptanceCriteria: Method cancels any in-flight debounce before firing its write.
Immediate write includes relink transactions consistent with updateGroceryItemOnly semantics (cloud vs local pick).
Snapshot is updated in place so that subsequent diffItemSnapshot calls compare against the picked saved_item's values.
No saved_items writes are performed as a direct consequence of the pick itself.
